- PII types: need confirmation that Redwood never persists raw PII from inference payloads in hosted mode; for Private/VPC we need clear controls on logging and retention.

- Data residency: primary requirement is US-only for now; later may need EU. Need confirmation on regions supported for Private deployments.

Deliverables we will provide by EOD Fri 2026-03-05:
- Draft private VPC dataflow diagram (high-level) 
- Logging & retention matrix by deployment type (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- Answers to the spreadsheet where we can provide copyable text

Quick answers to a few items now:
- PII: For Hosted we have configurable request/response logging; customers can opt out of storing full request bodies and enable redaction. For Private/VPC deployments, all inference traffic stays in your VPC and we do not persist customer inference payloads in our hosted control plane by default  we'll document exactly where artifacts may be stored for ops (e.g., metrics, traces).
- Data residency: Private deployments can be hosted in specified cloud regions or deployed on-prem; EU residency is supported via EU-hosted Private instances but requires provisioning.
- On-prem / air-gapped: The runtime supports air-gapped environments but requires a managed install package and offline licensing; will list known blockers in the draft doc.

Attached: redwood_vpc_dataflow_draft.pdf (high-level diagram, draft)

I'll follow up with the matrix. Let us know if you want a short technical call with Michael to walk through the diagram.

Hi John  following up on the technical items. A few clarifications and notes from the infra perspective:

1) Network boundaries / egress
- For Private VPC deployments we deploy a customer-managed control plane within your VPC (or a private endpoint pattern) so inference traffic remains in-network. The only optional egress is for telemetry (opt-in) and automatic OS/security patch bundles for our managed runtime.
- If you need zero egress, we can provide an air-gapped installer; that disables automatic telemetry and requires offline proof-of-life checks performed locally.

2) Logging and retention
- Audit logs: We produce audit events (admin actions, provisioning) that can be configured to forward to your cloud logging/SIEM (CloudWatch/Stackdriver/Datadog).
- Request/response logging: configurable per-deployment. For Private deployments the default is no request/response persistence. When enabled, retention is configurable; typical options are 7/30/90/365 days. We support automated redaction rules to strip PII fields pre-persistence.

3) PII handling
- PII in inference payloads: we recommend a two-layer approach: (a) client-side redaction where feasible; (b) server-side redaction rules and keying to avoid storing raw PII.

4) On-prem / air-gapped constraints
- Known blockers: automatic model updates (if you want models updated you need a controlled update path); telemetry/health checks (handled via an offline aggregator or allowlist-based egress). Also hardware compatibility matrix for supported GPU instances  will include in the doc.

Attached: network_boundary_diagram.png (detailed diagram)
